correctness.rationale: For even-degree-conditioned G(n,p), the even-subgraph partition function Z_empty(t)=2^(−n)Σ_spin ∏_{ij}(1+tσ_iσ_j) with t=p/(1−p) follows from parity character orthogonality. Log fugacity mixed derivatives give C_inc= [t²/(1−t²)²]r2(1−r2), C_dis=same*(r4−r2²) for t≠1, where r_j=Z_A/Z_empty for |A|=j. At t<1, map to positive Curie–Weiss coupling β=atanh(t); conditional independent spins under Gaussian latent H have even moment ratios E(tanh²H)^j, giving 0<r2<1 and strictly r4>r2². Complementing all edges maps A to AΔ∂K_n and t to 1/t. If n odd, ∂K_n=∅ so positive signs persist. If n even, ∂K_n=[n], giving r2=m_j/m_(j+1)>1, r4=m_(j−1)/m_(j+1), j=(n−2)/2≥1, and Cauchy–Schwarz makes disjoint covariance positive while incident negative. At t=1 the uniform Eulerian binary cycle space has dual cut distance n−1≥3, so edge pairs independent. Independent exact rational cycle-space enumeration n=4..7 at five densities matches, while proof covers all n,p.
